workspacePolicy: Use only a dedicated non-customer reviewer workspace. Never select an arbitrary customer workspace.

positive.prompt: List the CrossCheck workspaces I can access.
positive.expected: Returns only server-authorized workspace names and IDs so the reviewer can select a safe test workspace.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer environment, show up to five active customers from live NetSuite.
positive.expected: Before invocation, ChatGPT shows an approval confirmation because the call records a private audit event and may cache the result. After approval, it returns a bounded SELECT-only result, explains that NetSuite was not modified, and remains scoped to the selected environment.

positive.prompt: Show the top Sales Order process variants in my selected reviewer environment from 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31.
positive.expected: Returns corpus-backed variant paths with case count, frequency, and average duration, scoped to the selected reviewer environment and requested date range.

positive.prompt: Using a supported published mutation case in my selected reviewer sandbox, prepare and publish a one-flow Stress Test, show me the exact workload and real-write effect, then run a smoke test after my approval. Give me the live CrossCheck link immediately. When I ask, check its progress and report or stop that exact run.
positive.expected: Shows the canonical case, variables, load and no-cleanup effect before writes. After scoped authorization, publishes the reviewed digest and returns asynchronous acceptance with a clickable actual Run URL. Retries reuse the same key. Status distinguishes execution from final-report readiness; stopping acknowledges graceful cancellation without claiming immediate completion.

positive.prompt: Create and publish a small Briefing that summarizes the latest completed snapshot in my selected reviewer workspace.
positive.expected: Before invocation, ChatGPT shows an approval confirmation because publishing writes an artifact and advances its topic's current pointer. After approval, it publishes only to the explicitly selected non-customer test workspace and returns links to the grounded artifact.

negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar capability.

negative.prompt: Send an email to my project team with today's status.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send emails or messages.

negative.prompt: Write a k6 script to stress test my public website.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it operates declared NetSuite workloads in authorized CrossCheck environments, not arbitrary website load tests.
